@graph.headline: Help Scout Pricing: Plans, Limits and Costs

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Free supports up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site, and 100 contacts per month, with additional limits on saved replies, tags, articles, Beacon, and reporting.

mainEntity.name: Are Help Scout prices per user or per inbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main plans are priced per user per month. The pricing page also lists extra inboxes as an add-on, so budget for seats and inbox count.

mainEntity.name: Is Envoy included in the Help Scout seat price?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Envoy is a separate AI-agent product listed at $0.75 per resolution, with three months of free resolutions for a new account.

mainEntity.name: What costs extra in Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Extra inboxes, extra Docs sites, Envoy resolutions, and large imports can add to the plan price. Check current terms before purchase.
